text:
deploy-bot: Deploy complete for canary group eu-west1 — rollout v2026.3.25. Starting post-deploy smoke probes now. https://deploys.internal/redwood/rollouts/1768881230
synth-bot: SYNTH ALERT (prefill): 5 prefills failed in the last 2m on host eu-canary-3. Error snippet: "open /tmp/tokenizer_cache_XXXXX: no such file or directory"
alice: saw the alert, thx. anyone reproduced on host shell?
bob: quick look at eu-canary-3 syslog: /tmp usage at 93%, a bunch of orphaned tmpfiles owned by runtime user. grep shows repeated tokenizer init creating temp files and not removing them. log sample:
```
May 03 12:34:10 eu-canary-3 runtime[1987]: tokenizer: creating tmp /tmp/tokenizer_cache_u3h2
May 03 12:34:10 eu-canary-3 runtime[1987]: tokenizer: failed to cleanup tmp: permission denied
```
carol: that's from the tokenizer change in this release (PR #4129). It switched to using tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile without delete=True on NFS mount. On canary that creates persistent files.
dave: how many canary hosts affected? is it single host or a fanout?
synth-bot: breakdown: eu-canary-1 OK, eu-canary-2 OK, eu-canary-3 5 failures, eu-canary-4 1 failure (disk warning).
matt: SLO-wise canary is dipping. Disk pressure risks broader failure if not addressed. I'd prefer to pin to previous model variant and run hotfix instead of letting canary continue.
carol: agree — two options: (A) pin canary routes back to rwd-llm-v3b-quant@sha256:prev456 (pre-change) which is fast and reversible, or (B) run a cluster cleanup job to rm /tmp/tokenizer_cache_* and continue the roll — but cleanup is brittle if process keeps creating.
alice: lean pin + hotfix. less blast radius.
bob: if we pin, we should also kick a cleanup job to free space on eu-canary-3 to avoid reoccurrence when we re-roll. I'll prepare a safe delete with a regex and pre-flight check.
carol: will open ENG-3417 for the tokenizer fix (use tempfile with explicit close and tmpfs on startup). I can cut a hotfix patch + changelog. ETA 2h for patch and CI run.
alice: ok executing pin now.
deploy-bot: Updating routing policy: pin canary (eu-west1) -> rwd-llm-v3b-quant@sha256:prev456. Applying change... done. Canary traffic switched. Post-pin smoke will restart automatically.
synth-bot: INFO: post-pin smoke triggered. Initial probes OK for eu-canary-1/2/4, eu-canary-3 pending cleanup.
dave: running cleanup job on eu-canary-3: `kubectl exec -n runtime eu-canary-3 -- /bin/sh -c "find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'tokenizer_cache_*' -type f -mtime +0 -print -delete"` — will monitor.
bob: monitor syslog and disk. alert if /tmp > 85% after cleanup.
matt: good call. once cleanup stabilizes, we can re-run a controlled canary of the patched build. keep release window open for 3 hours for hotfix.
carol: pushed ENG-3417 with minimal repro, tests, and patch branch `fix/tmp-cleanup-4129`. I’ll request expedited CI.
alice: documented in release notes: rollback pin + investigation + follow-up PR. tagging stakeholders.
deploy-bot: Rollout summary: pinned canary -> prev variant, triggered cleanup job, synth smoke re-run queued. Thread closed after next smoke pass.
